svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-aviator-shirt-female-epaulet-sleeve-cadet-officer","name":"Women's Aviator Shirt Uniform cadet officer epaulet sleeves (overlay, registered to garment-aviator-shirt-female; blank grade)","size_in":{"w":25.3352,"h":31.4042},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2533.52,3140.42],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The slide-on epaulet sleeve as it lies on the shirt's strap: the strap polygon itself (0.9 in wide, one axis from the armhole seam to the collar end) cut square across 0.5 in + the button + 0.06 in short of the strap's point so the button shows; same outer end, same two long edges, upper edge the shoulder line, so it covers the strap and nothing else (Fig 4.16: the gray sleeve is as wide as the strap, 0.88-0.94 in at the pocket's 5.25 in). The top-down view is the separate asset garment-aviator-epaulet-top-*. Colours are those of the top-down sleeve assets (rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-* #5f5c5c, measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1; cadet officers the family grade-cloth blue #142347, assets/epaulet-sleeve-colours.js), as the Class B sleeves, so the strip on the shirt and the view from above show one sleeve; the regulation gives no shade or dimension.","anchors":{"top_center":[1266.76,0],"bottom_center":[1266.76,3140.42],"center":[1266.76,1570.21],"left_edge":[0,1570.21],"right_edge":[2533.52,1570.21],"rank_slot_right_center":[509.74,341.11],"rank_slot_left_center":[2013.78,353.99],"rank_rule_point_right":[370.82,378.54],"rank_rule_point_left":[2155.67,393.49]},"landmarks":{"epaulet_sleeve_right":{"x":291.27,"y":241.05,"w":436.95,"h":195.18},"rank_slot_right":{"x":291.27,"y":241.05,"w":436.95,"h":195.18},"epaulet_sleeve_poly_right":[[291.27,353.37],[305.71,351.63],[363.49,329.79],[479.04,296.23],[704.55,241.05],[728.22,328.86],[329.68,436.23]],"epaulet_sleeve_left":{"x":1792.49,"y":250.76,"w":442.57,"h":200.85},"rank_slot_left":{"x":1792.49,"y":250.76,"w":442.57,"h":200.85},"epaulet_sleeve_poly_left":[[2235.07,368.87],[2148.4,338.14],[2061.73,312.06],[1902.85,270.76],[1817.09,250.76],[1792.49,339.13],[2196.7,451.61]]},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-aviator-shirt-female","documented":["blue epaulet sleeves, miniature grade (CAPR 39-1 4.2.5.1.1.4 / 4.2.6.2.4)","grade insignia centred 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 36-2903 4.5.1.1.1)"],"assumed":["sleeve length (ends short of the strap button)","grade not drawn: placed by the rank insignia assets at rank_slot (centre of the sleeve, on the strap axis)"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
